english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the mint plant, and it can also name the mint flavoring when the food or drink context is clear.

examples.english: I like adding a little mint to iced lemon tea.
examples.traditional: 我鍾意喺凍檸茶入面加少少薄荷。
